title: Marketing Analytics & Attribution
description: Measure what works and make data-driven marketing decisions. Tests dashboard design, attribution modelling, and marketing mix analysis.

seo.overviewTitle: Marketing Analytics & Attribution Modeling (GA4 & UTM Tagging)
seo.overviewBody: Marketing analytics attributes revenue to specific marketing channels. Analytics managers seek candidates skilled in configuring Google Analytics 4 (GA4) custom events, establishing standardized UTM tagging, and evaluating attribution models (First Touch, Last Touch, Data-Driven).

deliverables.title: 1. GA4 Event Tracking & UTM Taxonomy Spec
deliverables.desc: Governance guide defining UTM naming conventions (source/medium/campaign) and custom GA4 conversion event parameters.

deliverables.title: 2. Multi-Channel Attribution Analysis Report
deliverables.desc: Analytical report comparing acquisition performance across First Touch, Last Touch, and Data-Driven attribution models.

deliverables.title: 3. Executive Marketing Performance Dashboard
deliverables.desc: Data dashboard visualizing channel conversion rates, customer journey paths, and campaign ROI.

faqs.question: What is the difference between First-Touch and Last-Touch attribution?
faqs.answer: First-Touch attributes 100% of conversion value to the initial brand discovery channel. Last-Touch attributes 100% of conversion value to the final channel clicked immediately before purchase.

faqs.question: Why is consistent UTM parameter capitalization critical?
faqs.answer: Analytics tools treat 'facebook' and 'Facebook' as two distinct traffic sources, fragmenting reporting data.

faqs.question: How did Apple iOS 14.5+ affect digital marketing tracking?
faqs.answer: App Tracking Transparency (ATT) allowed users to opt out of cross-app tracking, limiting third-party ad pixel attribution and requiring server-side Conversions API (CAPI) setups.
